summary: Iteration 47 verifies the pending-models workflow, per-key rate-limit tracking (key_status), and news_watcher.deep_on_news toggle end-to-end. All 7 backend pytest cases pass (login, catalog>=20 pending & empty discovered, approve->401 without token, unknown model->400, approve+dismiss+catalog verify, roles toggle). Frontend flow verified via Playwright: Admin login via lock icon -> KI-Trader strategy tab -> gear (edit params) opens AITradingPanel -> ai-team-toggle -> ai-pending-models visible with 31 approve/dismiss buttons; clicking approve removes the row, shows Sonner toast 'gemini · gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview freigeschaltet – jetzt auswählbar'; ai-role-news-deepanalysis toggles true<->false with persistence and no errors.

Both toggle 'Tiefenanalyse bei News'; functionality works, but duplicate testids can break single-selector tests. Consider suffixing (e.g. -a/-b) or removing the duplicate render.
